# VehicleOneHit

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** VehicleOneHit

## What it does

VehicleOneHit is an exploit module that destroys any vehicle — boats and minecarts — in a single hit. Normally it takes many swings to break a vehicle in vanilla Minecraft, but this module sends the required number of attack packets automatically the moment you land your first hit, making the vehicle disappear instantly.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/vehicleonehit). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
